fixes.explanation: Right, baker. Verse 9 says the Teacher "…also taught the people knowledge…" (Ecclesiastes 12:9). The Teacher was king in Jerusalem (Ecclesiastes 1:1), and the wisdom went out to the people. Keeping it all to himself doesn't match that, so False is the answer.

A half-out nail is how you rip a sleeve, baker. The text describes them as "…firmly embedded nails driven by a single Shepherd." (Ecclesiastes 12:11). Nothing in that verse says the nails are left half out. The picture is of nails that were driven in and set, so this isn't the one.

problems.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It still treats ‘firmly embedded’ as ruling out a nail being half out, though a firmly embedded nail can protrude.
